certificates-mounted-tls-certs-csi-secret-store mounted-tls-certs csi-secret-store UNTESTED
Description
Installs the secrets-store-csi-driver helm chart and a stub SecretProviderClass, then installs the chart with a TLS secret volume. Verifies CSI driver presence, SecretProviderClass resource, and that the product pod serves HTTPS. Full CSI volume mount verification requires a real CSI provider plugin (e.g. AWS Secrets Manager, GCP Secret Manager, Azure Key Vault, or HashiCorp Vault) which is not available on kind; the scenario validates CSI infrastructure deployment and documents the mount verification as a SKIP on kind.
